summary.en: If you lost, soiled or damaged your licence, apply for reissue at the driving licence test centre or similar. The test centre and the Higashi-Mikawa centre issue it the same day; applying at a police station means collecting it later (to be checked). Nishi and Minato police stations do not handle reissues. The fee amount is not on the page (to be checked).

text.en: The driving licence test centre, the Higashi-Mikawa centre, or 23 police stations. Nishi and Minato police stations do not accept reissues (to be checked)

text.en: The test centre and the Higashi-Mikawa centre issue the licence the same day. Applying at one of the 23 police stations means collecting it on a later day (to be checked).

evidence.quote: 23警察署で再交付申請を行う場合には、後日交付となります。

text.en: One photo is required (taken within 6 months, bareheaded, facing front, plain background). Your own photo is not accepted; it is taken at a dedicated photo machine (to be checked).

evidence.quote: 持ち込み写真による再交付は行っておりません。

text.en: ID: a photo ID such as a passport, My Number Card or residence card. Without a photo ID, several documents are needed (to be checked).

evidence.quote: ご本人であることを確認することができる書類（下記1又は2のいずれか一方）

text.en: If you also change your address, bring one document showing the new address. A change of address from outside the prefecture cannot be accepted at a police station (to be checked).

text.en: Pay the fee with Aichi revenue stamps or cashless payment. Stamps of other prefectures are not accepted. The amount is not on the page (to be checked).

evidence.quote: 愛知県収入証紙又はキャッシュレスにより納付

text.en: No service on Saturdays, public holidays, substitute holidays or 29 December to 3 January. The test centre's service days can change, so check before you go (to be checked).
